title: docs(spec): the compactToolbar describe and the userActions liveness note say which toolbar draws Refresh

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9Gqqp1VYZwEqbXEm1YsTjU)_

Clause-②: no

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziH9MVhWYLVCiw5eXB

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：视图元数据里「紧凑工具栏」这一项的说明文字改了，写明默认就是紧凑工具栏、紧凑工具栏上没有刷新按钮；界面与行为都不变。
- 属于「列表页重做」专题的收尾：上一轮已把「刷新开关只管宽工具栏」写进刷新开关的说明，这次把相邻的工具栏说明和审计台账补齐。
- 出错时最坏是说明文字不准，作者或智能体误判某个开关管哪个工具栏；只改文字，可整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the `compactToolbar` describe: the first sentence is kept and two are added. It now says the compact toolbar is on by default (omitted or `true`; `false` draws the wide toolbar, one button per control) and that the compact toolbar draws no Refresh button, so `userActions.refresh` governs only the wide toolbar; pull-to-refresh is unaffected by either key. The wording follows the `userActions.refresh` describe that #36339 landed ("Governs only the wide toolbar's Refresh button (`compactToolbar: false`): the default toolbar has no Refresh, so the toggle changes nothing there.").
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`: the view form's `compactToolbar` hint mirrors the new describe. The hint == describe pin (`src/ui/view-form-composite-children.test.ts`, "top-level rows that gained a hint carry their schema description") requires it.
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, the `userActions` note: the `userActions.refresh` sentence now says it drives only the wide toolbar's Refresh button and names the reader by line: `showRefresh` at `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2710`, the button at `:8125` behind `!compactToolbar`, measured at `5c2e34cdb`. The verdict stays `live`.
- Regenerated, not hand-edited: `content/docs/references/{ui/view,data/object,api/protocol}.mdx` (`check:generated --fix`, which found only `check:docs` stale) and `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`; translated locales keep their wording).
- Changeset `.changeset/36353-compact-toolbar-refresh-describe.md`: patch for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

Description text only. `compactToolbar` stays `z.boolean().optional()` and `userActions.refresh` is not touched, so no key, type, default or optionality changes and the accept set is the same.

What the new sentences rest on, read on `origin/main` `5c2e34cdb` (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`):
1. Default: `compactToolbar: schema.compactToolbar !== false` (`:2718`). The plugin-list registry input already says "On by default; `false` draws one toolbar button per control" (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx:236`).
2. No Refresh in the compact toolbar: the only Refresh button is `toolbarFlags.showRefresh && !toolbarFlags.compactToolbar` (`:8125`, `data-testid="refresh-button"`). `ViewSettingsPopover` gets no refresh prop (the `viewSettingsElement` at `:7548`), and `components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` has no `refresh` hit at all.
3. Pull-to-refresh: `usePullToRefresh({ onRefresh: handlePullRefresh, enabled: !!dataSource && !!schema.objectName })` (`:3680`), attached unconditionally to the list root (`ref={pullRef}`, `:7637`). It reads neither `compactToolbar` nor `userActions.refresh`.

Prior rulings: `check-prior-rulings --paths` over both files lists 146 hit lines. The ones near the edited lines (view.zod.ts `:3710` ruling 6095014058 letter A on `sharing`, `:3733` #15184 ruling B on composition order, `:1935`/`:1946` the `hideFields`/`editInline` defaults; view.json `:236`, `:250`, `:254`) are about other keys, and none governs `compactToolbar` or the refresh scope. No ADR names `compactToolbar`. The scope sentence restates what #36339's describe already says (contract review record 7076152814, N2 and N3), and no ruling is reversed.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the `compactToolbar` line: this is the published schema text, and the contract review reads it.
2. `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, the `userActions` note: the line numbers it cites.

## Tests

Final head: `ca02fd3f8`. Every local reading below was taken against that head's tree.

<details><summary>Local readings (builds and tests under scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: rebuilt the package first, and regenerated only `check:docs` (`content/docs/references/**`), the one artifact it found stale. A re-run of `check:generated` then exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 885 passed (885), Tests 28146 passed, 1 todo (28147), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 125 passed (125), Tests 2126 passed (2126), exit 0. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- The hint == describe pin `src/ui/view-form-composite-children.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 20 passed (20), VERDICT command-exit 0. With `view-form-pagination.test.ts` and `view.test.ts`: 3 files, 573 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`: before the regeneration, "platform-objects: 1 bundle(s) drifted from the schema". After `--write --filter=platform-objects`: "OK (10 package(s), all bundles in sync)". This ran after the build of the `@objectstack/cli` + `@objectstack/platform-objects` closure (VERDICT command-exit 0).

</details>

No ablation and no reverse verification: the diff changes description text, a ledger note and generated output, and no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- Card "Done when" 1 (describe states the default, no Refresh in the compact toolbar, pull-to-refresh unaffected, matching `ListView.tsx` on `main`; form hint, regenerated docs and the hint == describe pin in step): done; see the three readings above. The pin passes.
- Card "Done when" 2 (liveness note names the wide-toolbar scope and the current reader line): done (`:2710` reader, `:8125` button).
- Noted, not filed: the note's first sentence still cites `ListView.tsx:374 toolbarFlags`, an older objectui line, for the whole `userActions` row. Only the refresh sentence is in this card's scope. Today the memo is at `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2700-2729`.
- Noted, not filed: the ten translated `compactToolbar` hints (and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts:440`) carry only the first sentence. They are still true, just less precise than English. Translating them is a translator's edit, as with #36339's `refresh` hint.
- Overlap: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` reports a textual conflict with #36802 in the generated `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` only. That file is routed `merge=os-regen` (`.gitattributes:159`), so whichever PR lands second regenerates it with `check:generated --fix`. It merges cleanly against `origin/main`, #36857 (which shares `view.zod.ts`) and #36858.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/view-form-composite-children.test.ts` shows 20 passed. `grep -n "compactToolbar: z" packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` shows the new describe after `z.boolean().optional()`.

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the final diff named 112 commands, and all of them ran locally. The `--ran` reconciliation reads "112 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- 108 exited 0. The other four:
  - Exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, so NOT MEASURED locally (CI measures them): `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, because the shallow clone cannot reach its pinned fixture commit; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, because the whole-tree dist is absent; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`, because some workspace dists are absent.
  - Exit 1: `pnpm check:platform-checklist`, "ABSENT SYMBOL `packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.ts#anonymousFormExplicitWithdrawals`" in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`. This diff touches neither file. The symbol is absent from that source at the base `5c2e34cdb` and at the current `origin/main` `d9c799c10`, so it is red independently of this PR, and it is reported to the seat.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0. `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`: exit 0. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: see Acceptance notes.
- `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` (a local-only family): exit 1, "the workspace is not built" (44 of 108 package dists absent in this container). This describes the machine and says nothing about the diff.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived mandate.

</details>
